snippet.title: Find My Frogs | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
🐸🔍✨  Find My Frogs is a cozy hidden object game where you search for frogs and toads in a peaceful, hand-drawn village. Explore charming spots, uncover secrets, and help Uncle Froger gather everyone for a family photo.

✨ Get Find My Frogs on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3130800/Find_My_Frogs/
